location: CH-R; formerly property of Church of St. Martin, Rheinfelden.
signature: : „MACHT x JACOB x PLÜS / AMPT ARBURG 1732“****
dimensions: bo 10.8, be 116, le 2544, slide sec. 1590, bell sec. 986, overlap 32, mp entry 12, slide exti 10, bell sec. entry 12.2., tube before bell bow 12, tube after bell bow 11.8.
remarks: Heavily restored. Two tubular slide stays, moveable one telescoping; floral-leaf pattern. Long patch on tenon. Repair on ferrule at upper tube adjacent to moveable slide stay. Inner slide tubes are of differently lengths; new work. Some ferrules have rings and dragon-scale pattern, others have just rings. Two patches in slide bow; no ring, no saddle, but there are indications that a saddle was once there. One flat bell stay, with eyelet (partially filled in), floral leaf pattern in Nuremberg style; hinge on bell pipe side, mounted on saddle with zigzag pattern. Bell bow has saddle with zigzag pattern, no ring. Much repair in bell sec. at ferrule after bell bow. Collar in bell; perhaps repair. Upper edge of garland has shell pattern, but plain, without fluting. Nuremberg-style rim wire with leaf pattern. Examined by the author, June 1999.
